name: Standard formats
description: Templates laid out after common label standards: GS1 logistic (SSCC) and UDI, ANSI Z535 safety, NFPA 70E arc flash, GHS chemical container, NFPA 704 diamond, TIA-606 cable ID, ECIA EIGP 114 reel, asset tag, shelf price label. Uses Team values for your company details. Turn off in Settings > Packs.
author: labebal
